visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, dark brown hair and bangs is positioned in the center of the frame, wearing a white textured sweater. She is in a well-lit indoor room with a large abstract painting on the wall behind her featuring geometric shapes in muted green and blue tones. To her right, a vase of artificial pink and white flowers sits on a surface. She looks directly at the camera, touching and ruffling her hair to demonstrate its dry and tangled texture while smiling. (2) The scene transitions to a medium shot where the woman's hair appears significantly smoother and more lustrous. She holds a transparent orange-tinted glass bottle with a gold pump, identifiable as L'Oreal hair oil, pointing at it with her right hand while gesturing with her left. Her facial expression is bright and enthusiastic, emphasizing the change in her hair's appearance. (3) A close-up shot follows, showing her hands rubbing the hair oil between her palms and then smoothing it onto the ends of her hair. A split-screen visual appears momentarily, comparing 'Before' and 'After' states of her hair strands to illustrate the product's effect. The background remains consistent with the soft-lit indoor setting. (4) The woman holds up two large, distinct hair product bottles—one gold and one brown—representing shampoo and conditioner from the same product line. She gestures with both hands towards the bottles, smiling warmly as she continues her presentation. (5) In the final segment, she showcases her long, smooth hair by shaking it gently and running her fingers through it. She displays her clean, non-greasy hands to the camera and holds the original hair oil bottle once more. Bright, colorful text overlays appear around her as she waves to the camera, concluding the demonstration in a cheerful manner.
